context: A community meeting wrap-up — two women chat at the entrance about neighbors
purpose: Teach: 伊藤/吉田/松本/小林/村上/主婦/タバコ/入り口

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、お疲れ様。入り口のところでちょっと話さない？
lines.en: Oh, good work today. Want to chat at the entrance for a bit?
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, casual and welcoming with a friendly invitation.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: いいわよ。今日は伊藤さんも吉田さんも来てたわね。
lines.en: Sure. Both Ms. Ito and Ms. Yoshida came today, didn't they.
lines.style: Relaxed aunt voice, gossipy and observant with familiar tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、松本さんと小林さんも久しぶりに顔出してたよ。
lines.en: Right, and Ms. Matsumoto and Ms. Kobayashi showed up after a while too.
lines.style: Casual chatter, warm and slightly excited about attendance.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 村上さんなんて、ずっと外でタバコ吸ってたじゃない。
lines.en: And Ms. Murakami, she was outside smoking the whole time, wasn't she.
lines.style: Slightly judgmental tone, mock-scandalized with a playful edge.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほんとよね。みんなただの主婦なのに、よく集まれるわよね。
lines.en: Really. We're all just housewives, but somehow we manage to gather.
lines.style: Reflective and warm, gentle pride mixed with light humor.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: でも伊藤さん、最近ちょっと元気なかった気がする。
lines.en: But Ms. Ito seemed a little down lately, I felt.
lines.style: Concerned aunt tone, lowering voice to show genuine worry.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ああ、わかる。今度入り口で会ったら声かけてみるね。
lines.en: Yeah, I get that. Next time I see her at the entrance I'll talk to her.
lines.style: Caring and resolved, soft but sincere promise to a friend.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん、お願い。じゃあまた来週ね。
lines.en: Yes, please. See you again next week.
lines.style: Warm closing tone, relieved and grateful with a friendly wave.
